subject.title: fix(feishu): upgrade single newlines to paragraph breaks in post md messages

question: Should this Feishu newline candidate remain blocked until live Feishu/Lark proof is attached, or may maintainers accept/generated-payload proof or run sandbox proof themselves?
rationale: The code path now looks coherent, but the user-visible bug depends on Feishu/Lark rendering behavior that generated payload output does not fully prove.

options.title: Require live proof before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until a redacted Feishu/Lark screenshot, recording, API transcript, or log from this branch shows corrected rendering and no near-limit delivery failure.

options.title: Maintainer runs sandbox proof
options.body: A maintainer with a sandbox tenant can run the proof path and attach the redacted artifact before merge if the contributor lacks credentials.

options.title: Choose a proof-positive sibling
options.body: If maintainers prefer a sibling candidate with stronger live proof after checking mergeability, designate that PR as canonical and close the remaining candidates afterward.

recommendation.title: Require live proof before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until a redacted Feishu/Lark screenshot, recording, API transcript, or log from this branch shows corrected rendering and no near-limit delivery failure.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin metadata names m1heng as the community owner for the channel plugin affected by this proof decision.
